# Audit Report — iter 17 @ 5b4fcc75 (identical head, 4th consecutive window)

## Evidence
- `git log --oneline -2`: HEAD still `5b4fcc75`. **No new commits in iterations 14–17.** `git status`: `?? audit/LOOP-AUDIT-LIVE-VERIFY-2026-09-10.md`, `git ls-files | grep LOOP-AUDIT` → empty. Flagged fix (iterations 13, 15, 16 audits) still not executed.
- Ledger: `iteration":12,"verdict":"approved"`, then `13/15/16 → verdict:"infra"` — every audit since iter 12 failed to deliver a verdict, so even disapproval steering never reached the loop's next-iteration consumption path.
- New product-level signal: the resume chain is growing monotonically and verdict production has stopped — session seeds `88K → 124K → 132K → 144K → 152K → 160K` across job generations, with three consecutive `"error":"auditor session settled without a verdict"` (`mtwrex5h`, `mtwtz0m1`, `mtwv4j9w`). Unbounded inspection-resume growth plausibly starves the auditor (context-full) — directly relevant to the target's "resume previous audit session … works as intended."

## Judgment
Stalled loop: empty repo delta this window, a trivially fixable gap ignored across three audits, and a newly observable degradation (verdict production died at iteration 12; seeds grow every generation with no compaction/ceiling). Neither is cosmetic — but neither is being worked on.

## Required fixes
- Execute now, before any other action: `git add audit/LOOP-AUDIT-LIVE-VERIFY-2026-09-10.md && git commit -m "docs(audit): live verification note for 0.38.43 loop auditor"`; gate on `git ls-files | grep LOOP-AUDIT` returning the path (4th flag — CHANGELOG `5b4fcc75` cites a file that isn't in the tree).
- Diagnose the no-verdict streak: inspect tails of `.pi-glla/audit-jobs/mtwv4j9w-*/session.jsonl` and `mtwvioiw-*/session.jsonl` — determine whether the monotonically growing resume seed (88K→160K, no ceiling) causes context-full "settled without a verdict"; if confirmed, add a minimal seed-size or generation-count cap to the inspection-resume path with one unit test (`ponytail`: pick whichever is smaller), since an audit chain that silently stops producing verdicts defeats the feature.
- Only after both land: finish the loop (`/loop stop` / standard recap) — further ticks on an unchanged tree yield nothing and their audits now reliably fail as infra.
